[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- [CustomDataSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:320) now resolves relation labels through `/api/entities/records`, but that endpoint requires `entities.records.view` ([records.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/core/src/modules/entities/api/records.ts:15)). The existing relation-options path only requires `entities.definitions.view` ([options.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/core/src/modules/entities/api/relations/options.ts:13)), and the host pages using this component are only guarded by module-specific features like [customers.people.view](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/[id]/page.meta.ts:3), [customers.companies.view](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/companies/[id]/page.meta.ts:3), and [sales.orders.view`/`sales.quotes.view](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/core/src/modules/sales/backend/sales/documents/[id]/page.meta.ts:3). For any role that can view these pages and custom-field definitions but not generic entity records, the new fetch will 403 and the code falls back to showing the raw UUID again ([CustomDataSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:789)). That means the fix does not actually hold for non-admin permission sets.

I couldn’t rerun the scoped `@open-mercato/ui` Jest test here because this worktree is missing Yarn’s install state; `yarn workspace @open-mercato/ui test --runInBand src/backend/__tests__/CustomDataSection.test.tsx` failed before test execution.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- [packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:768) preloads relation labels from `field.loadOptions()` and then treats any hit as fully resolved at [line 783](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:783). That skips the `/api/entities/records` fetch that is required for entity types whose href depends on extra record fields in [buildRelationHref](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:219), notably `customers:customer_entity` (`kind` decides person vs company), `customers:customer_person_profile` / `customer_company_profile` (`entity_id` is needed), and `catalog:catalog_product_variant` (`product_id` is needed). For any current value that appears in the first 50 options returned by `/api/entities/relations/options`, the UI now renders either no link or a wrong link even though the full record fetch would have produced the correct destination. The added test only covers the custom-entity fallback path, so this regression is currently untested.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- High: [CustomDataSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:301) now resolves missing relation labels exclusively through `/api/entities/relations/options`, and [relations/options.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/core/src/modules/entities/api/relations/options.ts:62) only fetches `id` plus the label field. But [buildRelationHref](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:181) still has supported branches that require full record data (`kind`, `entity_id`, `product_id`) to generate correct links. As a result, relation custom fields targeting `customers:customer_entity` lose their people/company link resolution, `customers:customer_person_profile` and `customers:customer_company_profile` can link to the profile UUID instead of the customer UUID, and `catalog:catalog_product_variant` can no longer build its nested product URL. The added UI test only covers the `virtual:*` fallback path at [CustomDataSection.test.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/__tests__/CustomDataSection.test.tsx:29), so this regression is not caught.

Scoped test reruns were not possible here because Yarn reports the worktree is missing its `node_modules` state file.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- [CustomDataSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:273) switched unresolved relation lookups from `/api/entities/records` to `/api/entities/relations/options`, but the new response only carries `{ value, label }`. [buildRelationHref](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:198) still relies on full record fields for several supported targets (`customers.customer_entity.kind`, `customer_person_profile.entity_id`, `customer_company_profile.entity_id`, `catalog_product_variant.product_id`). The new calls now pass only `entityId` and `recordId`, so those relation custom fields will lose or misroute their deep links in read-only mode even though the previous implementation handled them correctly. The added coverage in [CustomDataSection.test.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/__tests__/CustomDataSection.test.tsx:29) only exercises a `virtual:*` entity, so this regression is not caught.

Scoped validation I reran: `yarn workspace @open-mercato/ui test --runTestsByPath src/backend/__tests__/CustomDataSection.test.tsx --runInBand` passed.
[implementer-agent] Updated: Branch fix/hackon/hck-0035-bug-custom-fields-of-kind-39-relation-39-render-as-raw-uuids-instead-of was synchronized by the coordinator.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- [CustomDataSection.tsx](</home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:463>) and [CustomDataSection.tsx](</home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:518>): `resolveOptionDisplay()` now returns a display for any non-empty scalar value, not just relation/select values. Because `formatFieldValue()` returns that result before the markdown branch at [CustomDataSection.tsx](</home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:532>), existing read-only `text` / `textarea` / `richtext` custom fields stop rendering through the markdown preview path and fall back to literal text. That is a broad regression in a shared detail component, so I would block on it.

Scoped check: `yarn --cwd packages/ui test --runTestsByPath src/backend/__tests__/CustomDataSection.test.tsx` passes, but the new coverage only exercises relation fields and would not catch the text/richtext regression above.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- [customFieldRelationDisplay.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/utils/customFieldRelationDisplay.ts:318) pre-seeds relation displays from `definition.options`, but [collectRelationDisplayRequests](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/utils/customFieldRelationDisplay.ts:335) only refetches ids that are completely missing. For entity types that need route context to build the correct link ([same file](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/utils/customFieldRelationDisplay.ts:119), [same file](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/utils/customFieldRelationDisplay.ts:143)), those pre-seeded entries can have no `href` at all or a wrong fallback (`customer_person_profile` / `customer_company_profile` fall back to the profile id when `entity_id` is absent). The new list consumers now depend on this hook, for example [people/page.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/core/src/modules/customers/backend/customers/people/page.tsx:291). Relation definitions are allowed to carry static `options` today ([definitions.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/core/src/modules/entities/api/definitions.ts:251)), so this is a real supported path, not just hypothetical. The detail component already refetches when a display exists but lacks route-context-backed hrefs; the shared table hook needs the same guard.

Scoped evidence: `yarn workspace @open-mercato/ui test --runTestsByPath src/backend/__tests__/CustomDataSection.test.tsx src/backend/__tests__/CustomFieldTableValue.test.tsx` and `yarn workspace @open-mercato/core test --runTestsByPath src/modules/entities/api/__tests__/relations.options.test.ts` both passed. `typecheck` was not actionable here because the workspace baseline is missing generated `#generated/*` modules.

[reviewer-agent] Non-blocking:
- [customFieldRelationDisplay.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/utils/customFieldRelationDisplay.ts:323) seeds `initialDisplays` from `definition.options` and only fetches when an id is missing, but [CustomDataSection.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0035/packages/ui/src/backend/detail/CustomDataSection.tsx:547) already shows that some relation types need a second lookup when the preseeded display has no `href`. In table views, route-context-dependent relations such as `customers:customer_entity` or `catalog:catalog_product_variant` can therefore stop at plain text when `definition.options` already contains the label. I’d mirror the `needsRouteContext && !display.href` check in the shared hook and add a `CustomFieldTableValue` test for that case.

Scoped validation: `yarn workspace @open-mercato/ui test --runInBand src/backend/__tests__/CustomDataSection.test.tsx src/backend/__tests__/CustomFieldTableValue.test.tsx` passed. `node_modules/.bin/tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json --noEmit` is currently blocked by the existing missing generated module `#generated/entities.ids.generated` from `packages/core/src/generated-shims/entities.ids.generated.ts`, which does not appear tied to this patch.
